title: Plan P1-003 append-only audit verification
businessObjective: Make P1-003 audit contracts bounded, static, deterministic, and independently verifiable before any audit subsystem implementation.
technicalObjective: Define a closed append-only audit-contract artifact and exact offline validator command, then amend P1-003's packet without creating an audit store or live service.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P1-003 produces static repository audit-contract artifacts only; it must not access an audit database, execute SQL, write live records, or invoke a service.
The append-only property is a contract-level invariant; retention, legal policy, personal-data handling, authorization, RLS, and operational deletion behavior are excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design defines one bounded static append-only audit-contract artifact and deterministic invalid-input behavior.
P1-003 uses exact future command node tests/audit/validate-append-only-audit-contract.mjs.
P1-003's packet removes invented npm test indirection, both packets validate, and independent review confirms protected paths remain untouched.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-GOV-019 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
solEscalationTriggers: Any audit-store, database, migration, record-deletion, retention, legal, privacy, authentication, authorization, RLS, production-write, or live-service scope.
Any attempt to treat a static append-only contract as enforcement of a live operational record store.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the audit design document, P1-003 packet amendment, evidence, and this task packet; retain any historical verification evidence.

includedPaths: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
